sessions.title: Thierry Frémaux’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The general delegate of the Cannes Film Festival and the director of the Institut Lumière—whose film Lumière, le cinéma! is now playing on the Criterion Channel—shares his personal journey through cinema, highlighting such favorites as Pierrot le fou, 2046, Budd Boetticher’s Ranown westerns, and Il posto.
